Harrison Street expanded its senior housing platform with three PGIM Real Estate hires as its investment and exit activity in the sector grows.

Harrison Street Asset Management is set to grow its healthcare real estate platform as senior housing investment opportunities abound. With $16 billion invested across 46,000 units, Harrison Street remains one of the largest private owners of senior housing in the U.S. and is looking to expand the business.
